skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Heritage
skins.content: EPOQUE Line [Passe] Series Selects/Heritage. Traditional Minoan ritual attire, coordinated with modern themes, is once again in vogue among Minoans.
skins.quote: 'What we've inherited is much more than just these outfits, but the ideology, the principles, and the future as well.'

skins.name: A Drip of Orea and Potamous
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/A Drip of Orea and Potamous. Designed for the climate of Minos, slim-fitting and easy to move in. The fabric is durable, waterproof, and resistant to the occasional spilled wine. Can be customized with extras to the customer's needs.
skins.quote: The drunken traveler walks her homeland's mountains and rivers. A new epic is poured into the temple that the twelve heroes retook.
